title: Stasis: Inverted Fusion
description: A surreal chalk-style drawing on black background depicts a tall multi-eyed alien creature with four arms standing on a glowing geometric platform, holding a small glowing orb containing a deer head. To the left, a small armored astronaut figure holds a staff. Above them floats a large cracked red planet with rings and purple crystalline growths, surrounded by geometric patterns, floating orbs, and triangular symbols.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork on black background in white and colored chalk style. A tall four-armed alien creature with multiple eyes stands on a glowing geometric platform, holding a small orb with a deer head inside. A small armored astronaut stands to the left holding a staff. In the sky is a large cracked red planet with rings and purple crystal formations. Scattered geometric triangles, floating orbs, and mystical symbols fill the dark space around them.
